newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GP Batteries to issue 10 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: GP Batteries to issue 10 mln shares.

text.p: GP Batteries International Ltd is offering 10 million shares into the Singapore market, placement agents DBS Securities and Peregrine Securities said on Thursday.

The shares, priced at Singapore $4.43 each, comprise seven million new shares, which would be placed out to institutions, and three million vendor shares, which would be available to the retail market, the agents told Reuters.
No further details were immediately available.
GP Batteries is the Singapore-listed subsidiary of Hong Kong Gold Peak Industries (Holdings) Ltd.
